title: Logistics Fleet
summary: Fleet management page with a split layout: left side has a 'Fleet' panel listing vehicles with their status, driver name, and location details in a scrollable list. Right side shows a large interactive map (appears to be a Leaflet/Mapbox map) with vehicle location markers. The map shows a New York area view with multiple vehicle pins.

layout.columns: Left vehicle list panel (~25%) with scrollable fleet entries, right map view (~75%) with vehicle markers
